name: Queue one official Government Plaza prerequisite or spy building with real city progress

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert((p.stage=='BUILD_TIER1' or p.stage=='BUILD_SPIES') and p.capacity==1 and p.occupied==1,'official building prerequisites not ready: '..p.stage); b.Queue('BUILD_CAPACITY'); return p.buildingType

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BUILD_CAPACITY' or a=='REJECTED_BUILD_CAPACITY' then error(a) end; return a=='READY_BUILD_CAPACITY'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.CaptiveCapacityPlan().stage=='BUILD_QUEUED','native building queue not observed'); b.Queue('PROGRESS_CAPACITY'); return 'one official city progress request queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PROGRESS_CAPACITY' or a=='UNKNOWN_PROGRESS_CAPACITY' or a=='REJECTED_PROGRESS_CAPACITY' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PROGRESS_CAPACITY'

steps.code: local p=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_PROGRESS')); return 'native progress recorded; building and capacity require a real turn'
